title: Java security warning
summary: If the Java your game runs on has the Java4Shell security flaw, Dungeon Train now tells you when the game starts and shows you how to fix it: update Java, or add one setting to your launcher.
highlights: The steps match your setup, whether your Java comes from the Minecraft Launcher, CurseForge, Modrinth, Prism or your own install.
Only computers the flaw affects see it. Macs with Apple chips never do.
